verdict.rationale: Brex advertises a business account yielding "up to 3.70%", alongside fast global payments and banking in 120+ countries, so earning interest on balances is supported. Nothing shows that interest accrues on balances held in currencies other than the primary one; "global" refers to payments and coverage, not multi-currency yield. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-currency balance holding, evidence of interest earned on non-USD balances, detailed documentation of rates or terms per currency, and independent corroboration.
